title: bybit_1 demo is margin-starved: available 120 USD of ~122k equity, so every new bybit_1 entry is risk_refused (desk probe #2 refused 18:07Z)
note: OBSERVED 2026-10-27 ~18:10Z (manager, MEASURED): (1) desk mechanics probe #2 (DD-20261027T1803Z-scan-1h-1, BTCUSDT long, entry 80511 SL 80100 TP 80830.9) was accepted by intake and dispatched, then refused by RiskManager: 'risk_refused: sized_qty=0 with balance=122428.48 available_usd=0.00 total_account_usd=122436.53 direction=long market_type=linear — check daily-loss budget / liquidation buffer / max_borrow' (journalctl ict-trader-live 18:07:00Z). (2) /api/diag/broker_account_status: bybit_1 available_margin read_state venue_available, available_usd 120.23 (broker truth). With 11 open packages, initial margin consumes ~all equity. CONSEQUENCE: on the demo floor no NEW bybit_1 entry can size (desk, probes, every Stage-1 crypto leg) until positions close; the soak/probe mechanics are blocked by margin, not by code. OPEN QUESTIONS: per-symbol leverage on bybit_1 (likely low/1x vs risk_pct 0.0075 sizing at full notional); whether RiskManager should size against available margin and report it as a distinct refusal reason; 30d realized on bybit_1 -17.9k USD (bybit_wallet_truth). FIX OPTIONS (Tier 3, operator): raise bybit_1 leverage (venue setting) so notional fits margin; cap concurrent bybit_1 positions; or a per-account notional/margin budget in RiskManager.
